verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's documented automation is project alerts: new-issue events trigger emails to team members, and you can add a webhook URL as an alert recipient. Uptime monitors likewise send email or webhook alerts when a ping fails or is not received. Only the action side (notify or webhook) is evidenced, not a rule engine with user-defined conditions. Missing for 10: configurable rule conditions (filters, thresholds, frequency), actions beyond notifications/webhooks (e.g. auto-resolve, assign, issue creation), an API or MCP way to define rules, and independent hands-on corroboration.
